editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends make a huge mistake that changes your lives forever. You hit someone with your car, panic, and decide to hide the body to save your futures. You think you got away with it, but a year later, creepy notes start appearing and a killer begins hunting you down. The vibe is super tense and feels like a modern update to a classic slasher. You will feel the panic as the group turns on each other, wondering which one of them might be leaking their secrets or if the person they killed isn't actually dead.

The acting is surprisingly solid, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some of the scares are a bit predictable, the fast pace makes it a fun ride. If you love movies where secrets come back to bite people, you need to see this. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, so definitely stream it in the highest quality possible. If you are a fan of owning movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for those crisp visuals.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the killer is actually the sibling of the person hit in the accident. They spent the whole year tracking the friends down to make them suffer. In the final fight, the survivors manage to trap the killer in the same spot where the accident happened. After a brutal struggle, the killer is finally defeated, but the movie ends with a hint that the cycle of revenge might not be over for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slasher movies and twisty mysteries.
